title: [Decision] Setup → Metadata retirement: where the on/off switch of positions, permission sets and sharing rules lives — on the item in Studio (A) or kept in Setup (B)
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 — a decision the P2/P3 drafting review found undecided by ADR-0146 (cut 2026-11-01 on the maintainer's 「四项提速措施全部按推荐执行」). ⛔ Not a claim.

Part of #28236 (decision **M-1**) · Governing text: ADR-0146 D1 ("Setup carries no metadata editor and no metadata catalog"), D4 (the operational switch is offered on the item in Studio; the packaged-*action* switch keeps its disable leg where it is), D7 (⛔ "The redirects do not retire a Setup → Metadata route whose administrative action has no Setup home yet").

## Question

Where does the deployment on/off switch of **positions, permission sets and sharing rules** live after Setup → Metadata retires (#28578)?

**Measured (`50646f01f2`).** The switch is `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/catalog-activation.ts` on Setup's catalog item page, served by `packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts`. The four Setup entries reach those items through `?scope=environment` catalog routes. ADR-0146 moved the **flow** switch to the item in Studio (D4, landed as #28148) and kept the **action** switch in Setup (D4, out of this epic). It names no home for the catalog types.

## Options

| | Option | What it means | Work |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** (recommended) | The switch goes with the item, into Studio | On the item page in Studio's Access pillar / All metadata area (#28561), like the flow switch (D4). Setup keeps only the people pages (position holders, permission-set assignment, #28241). #28578 retires all four catalog routes. | Inside #28578 / #28561; no new card |
| B | The switch stays in Setup | Under D7 ⛔ the four catalog entries and routes stay in Setup as a catalog list, which D1 rules out; ADR-0146 would need a carve-out line. | ADR line + Setup keeps four routes |

## 维护者速读

- **问的是什么：** 岗位、权限集、共享规则这三类，管理员可以在本部署把某一项整体「停用」。这个开关今天在 Setup → 元数据的目录项页上。Setup → 元数据要撤（N-28），开关搬到哪里？
- **业务角度：** 停用一个权限集是运维动作，但它停用的是一项元数据。流程的同类开关已经按 ADR 搬到 Studio 的项上（#28148），动作的开关留在 Setup（不在本 epic）。这三类 ADR 没写。
- **实际需求：** 开关今天在用（Setup 目录页上真实可点），不是投机能力；两种方案都保留它，只是位置不同。
- **长远合理性：** A 与 D1「Setup 不放元数据目录」、D4「开关在项上」一致，一个规则管到底；B 要在 ADR 里为这三类开例外，Setup 留下一块目录列表，以后还会有人问「为什么这三类在 Setup」。
- **防 AI 写错：** A 只有一个家，AI 写界面时不会在两处各做一个开关；B 让同一类开关分处两个界面，容易写出两套。
- **创业期不扩散：** A 不新增任何能力，只是随页面一起搬；B 要多留四条路由和一段 ADR 例外。
- **席位推荐：A**。代价：只有 Setup 权限、没有 Studio 权限的管理员，停用这三类时要进 Studio（他们本来就看不到目录列表，ADR 已认这个代价）。
- **等这个答案的：** 只有 N-28 的第 2 项（四个目录入口与路由）；N-28 其余部分不等。

## How to answer

Reply with the option letter. The PM records it as a `Ruled:` comment here, copies it into #28578 item 2, and closes this card.

Links back: #28236, ADR-0146 D1 / D4 / D7, #28148, #28241.
